title: passiflora foetida f. quinqueloba
intro: Passiflora foetida f. quinqueloba, commonly known as Yellow Passion Flower, is a species of flowering plant in the Passifloraceae family. It is primarily valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, as well as its ability to provide relief from a variety of health issues. The health benefits of Passiflora foetida f. quinqueloba include its potential to reduce anxiety and insomnia, alleviate symptoms of menopause, and provide anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects.
